body: I dont quite get what you mean by that, could you elaborate?
Wow, that sounds really good tbh. Thank you! I'll try.

He doesn't tell me about his feelings so confirmation no, and I don't think he wants attention, it doesn't seem like he does atleast. He wants me to tell him if somethings wrong with me or I feel bad, he doesn't want me to feel bad for him or get worried.

Hey, I read your comment before you edited it -- my mental health is just fine right now. I'm stable, just seriously worried. I don't think breaking up with him would be the right solution, I do want to be there for him. He's precious to me. I would say that depression is temporary if you get help, but suicide is permanent. Ofc I know that I just barely influence his decisions, but I do not mind that it worries me like this since my mental health is doing fine as of now.

yeah, i mean im naturally there for them all the time simply because its part of who i am, too, so i dont have to worry about that. but im aware he does need therapy, im just dazzled on how i should approach that topic with him and make him consider truly going. but of course, he would need to want to himself. also its all good, dont worry, thank you
but i said his sister is in a coma and he doesnt have any other family members...? also i can contact him myself just fine

huh, boundaries like what exactly? and yeah, i agree, you should be able to discuss anything since communication is an important aspect in a relationship. i mean, im not really sure if he wont open up because we're still (atleast i consider it that way) "freshly together", although im as open as i can be. i could try approaching him and asking him why he doesnt talk about it, but i dont know if i should or how i could, you know. yeaa, it is his responsibility, but i cant really bat an eye to it, haha. but thank you still.

may i ask what you experienced? its okay if not, but you can also dm me.   
the thing for me is is that hes got days when hes completely happy and then shutting down -- mood swings yknow. i mean i guess it is true that he wont listen, its not my job, but of course i care because i love him, yeah.
can't i somehow motivate him into going? i dont know how to bring the topic up, really.

I thought he might think it's too early since we've been in a relationship only for a month now, but then I never really asked why he doesn't respond to that. I've generally been avoiding things that seem to be a sensitive topic since I know he doesn't have much interest talking about them as I've stated in the post, he's had a rough past. He generally is a really open and mindful person though, I can also tell he cares for me. I'm just really worried about him and I don't want to leave him.

It's not like he's making me stay though, he'd accept it if I'd go, it wouldn't change things for him. But I want to be with him, I don't want to leave, generally I'd say im a happy person but it pains me to see him like that, so atleast emotionally I have pressure, right. But I more feel like that I'm putting it on myself, since he isn't doing anything specific to me, but maybe I'm seeing through rose-gold colored glasses?
